items.title: Howard Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: I was greatly influenced by Louis Jordan.

ctx.x: For instance, what could I say? I was greatly influenced by Louis Jordan. Now Louis Jordan was very popular and his records, and you couldn’t say they weren’t jazz, they were the most modern jazz, and they were meant to be entertaining and funny and they were. They were rolickingly funny.
Rolickingly. That’s a good one. And he had the personality for it too, didn’t he?
